attacks.name: Pym Particle Punch
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
After this attack is resolved, this character may transform into |*Ant-Man (Tiny)|. If it transforms, it drops all Civilian objective tokens it is holding before transforming.

attacks.name: Bullet Ant Barrage
steps: After each attack is resolved, if it dealt |!damage|, the defender gains the |§poison§Poison| and |§stun§Stun| special conditions.

superPowers.name: Change Size
superPowers.body: This character drops all Civilian objective tokens it is holding, then transforms into |*Ant-Man (Tiny)|. The |*Change Size| superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Pym Particle Control
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by an enemy attack or would suffer a collision, it may use this superpower. This character drops all Civilian objective tokens it is holding, then transforms into |*Ant-Man (Tiny)| before the attack or collision continues.

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 5 to 6 on both Normal and Tiny forms.
Transforming to Tiny form now only drops Civilian objective tokens instead of all Objective tokens.
Hitch a Ride now requires this character to drop all Objective tokens it is holding before using the superpower.

attacks.name: Ant-Sized Uppercut
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
After this attack is resolved, this character transforms into |*Ant-Man (Normal)|.

superPowers.name: Change Size
superPowers.body: This character transforms into |*Ant-Man (Normal)|. The |*Change Size| superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Hitch a Ride
superPowers.body: This character drops all objective tokens it is holding. Then, Place this character within |!range| 3 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Stealth
superPowers.body: Characters must be within |!range| 3 of this character to target it with attacks.

superPowers.name: Tiny Superhero
superPowers.body: This character may reroll any number of its defense or dodge dice. Additionally, this character cannot hold Civilian objective tokens.
